title: Thai Caraway Seed Buns
description: Soft, fluffy buns infused with the unique flavor of caraway seeds, perfect for serving with your favorite Thai dishes.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Add warm water and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide into 6-8 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten into a disk.
Cut a small slit in the center of each disk to create a bun shape.
Place the buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush with slovakian butter and sprinkle with caraway seeds.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
